reasons_add: Ibn Mujāhid reports that Nāfiʿ opens the listed first-person yāʾs except in walī fīhā and akhī ushdud; Abū ʿAmr excepts walī fīhā and ḥashartanī aʿmā; Ibn Kathīr excepts walī fīhā, yassir lī amrī, lidhikrī in, ʿalā ʿaynī idh, and biraʾsī innī. Each opens the remaining listed yāʾs.
Ibn Mujāhid reports that Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, Ibn ʿĀmir, and ʿĀṣim through Abū Bakr keep all the listed first-person yāʾs quiescent.
Ibn Mujāhid says Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn Kathīr open the listed first-person yāʾs apart from their individually named exceptions; laʿallī is not among those exceptions.
